AllowedUsers.title: AllowedUsers
AllowedUsers.description: Authorized emails permitted to enter the application with roles (admin or viewer)

roles.description: Mapping from email to role (admin or viewer)

updatedBy.description: Email of user who made the update

SettingConfig.title: SettingConfig
SettingConfig.description: Application packing charge, inbound freight, and marketplace customer-return percentages

packing_per_dispatched_unit.description: Packing charge per dispatched unit in INR (default 6)

inbound_freight_per_purchased_unit.description: Inbound freight per purchased unit in INR (default 5)

updatedBy.description: User email who updated the settings

SettingAudit.title: SettingAudit
SettingAudit.description: Audit log record for changes made to application settings

setting_key.description: Name or key of the setting modified

user_email.description: Email of user who made the change

CostMasterItem.title: CostMasterItem
CostMasterItem.description: Cost master record with sku_code, sku_name, weight_grams, mfg_cost, active, and effective_from

mfg_cost.description: Manufacturing or base procurement cost in INR

active.description: Active status of SKU (soft delete when false)

createdBy.description: User who created this cost record

SkuVariantItem.title: SkuVariantItem
SkuVariantItem.description: Mapping from variant SKU to master SKU code (replaces marketplace mapping)

variant_sku.description: Unique variant SKU code across marketplaces

master_sku.description: Canonical SKU code in cost master

active.description: Active flag for the variant mapping

/allowedUsers/{docId}.description: List of authorized user emails and roles (admin or viewer)

/settings/{docId}.description: Application settings configuration and create-only audit log entries

/cost_master/{itemId}.description: Effective-dated cost master rows with weight_grams, mfg_cost, and active status

/sku_variants/{variantId}.description: Mappings from variant SKUs to canonical master SKU codes
